items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: I learned that, I didn't witness this now.

ctx.x: I was up on Lincoln Park one day, I don't know, let him tell me about it. He grew up there in the neighborhood.

I tell you all them things there. You learn everything in hand. Oh, I see, yeah, Buddy Bolden. He's quite a player, Buddy Bolden was. And in that day, he was a master, a loud trumpet player, very popular. He's, he's, I learned that, I didn't witness this now. Well I learned he was poisoned in his trumpet. It would kill him, see. Someone poisoned him to his trumpet. I learned that was his death. But because I'm no witness to that. I'm no witness to that. But I heard that was the way he was killed. It was through…
